content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works (address, headline, intro, photo peeking in), but the hours section stacks five identical full-width bars that eat a whole screen for one fact, and the services list is sparse text with large empty gaps.","desktopNote":"Hero is strong and well-composed, but below it the page thins out: the hours timeline repeats the same bar five times, 'Pridite po dogovoru' and 'Kdo pride k meni' leave the right half empty, and the header 'Rezervirajte termin', hero 'Naročite se na termin' and 'Izberite termin' are three bookings CTAs.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Collapse the hours into one line ('Pon–pet 7.00–20.00, samo po naročilu') or a compact table; the five identical bars add height without information on both viewports.","Fill the empty right half of 'Pridite po dogovoru' and 'Kdo pride k meni' on desktop with a second practice photo or give the service list icons/short descriptions so it stops reading as loose headings.","Keep one booking CTA per screen: drop 'Izberite termin' or the header button, and merge the duplicated phone/address blocks (hero bar, 'Obiščite nas', footer) into one contact block."],"blockers":[]}
